reportability_policy.official_quality_policy: ARC/SWE/MMMU quality is reportable only from official or explicitly authorized task snapshots with hidden material protected from the agent workspace.
reportability_policy.public_dev_policy: public/dev smoke scores are useful for regression but must be labeled local_or_incomplete unless dataset metadata marks them official_or_authorized
